title: Two campers arguing
description: Two campers are arguing loudly over a game or shared item.
steps: Calmly approach and ask both campers to pause and take a breath.
Separate them slightly so they can cool down and feel heard.
Listen to each camper one at a time without taking sides.
Ask each camper to repeat what they heard the other person say.
Guide them to suggest a fair solution together (taking turns, sharing, or choosing a new activity).
End by thanking them for working it out and reminding them of camp respect rules.

title: Camper feeling left out
description: A camper is sitting alone or not being included in group activities.
steps: Gently check in with the camper and ask how they are feeling.
Invite them to join a specific activity or give them a small helper role.
Pair them with a friendly camper or buddy for the next activity.
Watch the group for a few minutes and step in again if needed.
Talk briefly with the group about including everyone and being kind.

title: Camper not following rules
description: A camper repeatedly breaks a clear camp rule during an activity.
steps: Stop the behavior calmly and privately (away from an audience if possible).
Explain the rule and why it exists in simple, positive language.
Ask the camper to repeat the rule back in their own words.
Offer a choice: follow the rule and stay, or take a short break from the activity.
If the behavior continues, follow camp policy by involving a senior counselor or staff member.
